channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Jurors in Lindsay Clancy's trial visit the home where she killed her children
item.description: Jurors walked through the Massachusetts home where Lindsay Clancy strangled her three children, a rare visit that let them see firsthand the place where an outwardly ordinary family life unraveled.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Local doctor shares advice on preventing injuries as the fall sports season begins
item.description: Most kids in fall sports have already started to practice, but Dr. Patrick Mularoni emphasized the importance of getting your body acclimated to the heat because in the summer we are so used to sitting inside in the air conditioning.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Rays place pitcher Shane McClanahan on 15-day injured list with back tightness
item.description: Just days before the Major League Baseball trade deadline, the Tampa Bay Rays placed starting pitcher Shane McClanahan on the 15-day injured list with left back tightness, the team announced Friday.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Meteorologist in charge from the NWS in Ruskin joins Denis Phillips Live
item.description: Todd Barron is from the National Weather Service in Ruskin and has been the meteorologist in charge since March.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Bar fly says goodbye to Safety Harbor after 14 years, Frenchy's takes over location
item.description: Bar fly has closed its doors in Safety Harbor to focus on their new location in Palm Harbor; it's now under new ownership by Frenchy's. Neighbors share what the spot has meant to them over the years.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Mauch, Bucs eager for O-Line resurgence
item.description: Cody Mauch returned from a torn meniscus as Tampa Bay's projected starting offensive line reunites at training camp. The top unit didn't play a single snap together last season.

item.description: Tampa Bay 28 invited more than 200 candidates running in the Aug. 18, 2026, primary election across our area to a candidate photo, a 100-word biography, and responses to three questions.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Staying Parked to Stay Profitable: Tampa Bay food truck owner navigates rising food, fuel and supply costs
item.description: From higher beef prices to rising fuel and supply costs, a St. Petersburg food truck owner explains how inflation is reshaping the way she operates and serves customers.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Early voting for 2026 primary election starts Monday across Tampa Bay
item.description: Early voting for the 2026 primary election starts on Monday, Aug. 3, in Hillsborough County, officials say.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Feeding Tampa Bay hosts 3rd annual back-to-school event, serving over 500 families in Tampa Bay area
item.description: Feeding Tampa Bay's 3rd annual back-to-school event gave backpacks, supplies, and shoes to more than 500 Tampa Bay area families.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Sarasota man threw brick through synagogue window 'because it was Jewish place of worship': Police
item.description: A man was arrested after Sarasota police say he admitted to intentionally throwing a brick through the front window of a downtown synagogue because it was a Jewish place of worship.
